dia: Rated two or three stars out of high school (247Sports Composite) and later selected in the NFL Draft, any round.
t10: Selected with one of the first ten picks of the NFL Draft.
r1: Selected in the first round of the NFL Draft.
hype: A five-star recruit who was selected in the first round.
irr: The very last pick of his NFL Draft.
pay: Transferred through the portal to a new school, then was drafted.
jour: Played for three or more colleges on record (his signing school, portal moves and the school he was drafted from).
home: Signed with a school in his home state out of high school and was drafted from that same school.
pb: Selected to at least one Pro Bowl in the NFL.
ap: Named first-team All-Pro at least once in the NFL.
vet: Reached a fifth NFL season (NFL data through 2026).
tr: Has a transfer portal entry listing a school other than the one he signed with (2021 on).
juco: Signed with his college out of junior college.
hd: Signees at his position and recruiting tier (4-5 star or 2-3 star) at the school he plays for now (2002–2018 classes, 20+ players) were drafted at a rate in the top 10% of all such school groups (17% or higher). It reflects his school as much as his rating. It describes past players, not a prediction for him.
gem: A 2- or 3-star freshman (or 2027 commit, not signed yet) at a school whose 2- and 3-star signees at his position were drafted at a top-10% rate among all schools (10% or higher; 2002–2018 classes, 20+ players). It describes the school's history, not a prediction for him.
ht: His comparable group (signing route, star rating and position; 20+ players, 2020–2022 classes) is in the top 10% of all groups for share that later transferred (55% or higher). This describes past players like him, not a prediction for him.
